(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting selected database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the selected database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1, further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the selected database constructs.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with at least one least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time, wherein the modifying includes modifying the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted execution time and a historical actual execution time associated with the least cost query execution plan.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and a current performance associated with the execution resource, wherein the performance is determined based on historical performance data.
